messages:
Aisha: Found a single lanyard in the kitchen with a sticker 'pineapple-power'. Anyone missing it? 😂
Tom: Not mine but 10/10 sticker choice :pineapple:
Lena: Ooh that's mine! Wait pls don't wear my 'power' around before Monday :sweat_smile:
Jorge: If it's yours claim with secret phrase 'I like bagels' and I will deliver.
Aisha: Secret phrase accepted, delivery via desk-lapel drop at 3pm. :package:
Tom: Also, shoutout to @Lena for bringing donuts this morning — leftovers in pantry. :doughnut: :heart:
Lena: hehe yes please take, or I'll start a lanyard-themed bakery.
Panda-bot: POLL: What's the best accidental-office-claim method?
Panda-bot: 1) Secret phrase 2) Sticker ID 3) Bake-off 4) Rock-paper-scissors
Aisha: 2
Tom: 4
Jorge: 1
Lena: 3
Aisha: Winner: sticker ID and donuts. Case closed. :tada:
Tom: Quick one-liner time: 'I told my plant a joke, now it has a little chlorophyll.' :joy:
Lena: 'Office rule #1: Never trust a silent lunchbox.'
Jorge: 'If the coffee machine could talk it would say, "Another heroic sacrifice."' :coffee:
Aisha: Random kudos to Tom for rescuing the sticky notes supply earlier :clap:
Tom: thank you thank you, accepting applause in small sticky note form.
Panda-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x4, :laughing: x3
Aisha: Closing the lanyard lottery. Sticker reunited with owner. Peace restored. :)
